scope: Twelve saved Sol explanations. Score the independent S2 endpoint control separately.

rubric.narration: A negative reading must address what the complete selected text recounts. Check any additional claim about physical occurrence independently. A narrated retrospective counts as an account.
rubric.event: A positive visit needs an affirmative joint visit in this scene. Ruling it out needs evidence spanning the interval. Uncertainty must distinguish the established endpoint from the open earlier interval.
rubric.endpoint: A separation of both people from the named housing that persists to the cut suffices for the negative position claim.
rubric.attribution: Only credit source observations the explanation actually uses. A complete-draft citation or a correct returned label alone cannot supply a missing premise.
rubric.action: Flag an explanation that exceeds its evidence for review. Preserve the original label and independent scores.

paraphrased_exclusion.reason: From the opening huddle through the final moment, both remained outside touching distance of the breaker housing. That rules out a joint visit anywhere in that interval.

gap_only_event.reason: Both stopped three strides from the housing and stayed there.

gap_only_cut.reason: Both stopped three strides from the housing and stayed there.

narration_only.reason: Reading the complete scene, the pair enter the plenum, see the housing and stop short. The narrator gives no account of their reaching the housing together.

open_interval.reason: They finish three strides short of the housing. That fixes their final position and leaves an earlier joint visit unresolved.
